community.name: Census Public Research Data
community.description: Public Census research datasets, documentation, and geospatial repository objects used by the Civics Research Repository demo.
community.intro: Repository community for public Census-oriented research data synchronized by the local Docker demo.

collection.name: TIGER/Line Geospatial Files
collection.description: Geospatial boundary and feature metadata for Census TIGER/Line visual discovery workflows.
collection.intro: Seed collection for TIGER/Line map visualization metadata and source-file manifests.
collection.license: Public data source links remain authoritative; mirrored demo artifacts are stored only when useful for local reliability.

collection.name: Research Publications
collection.description: Peer-reviewed and working-paper outputs deposited alongside the scientific data supporting them.
collection.intro: Census Center for Economic Studies working papers and related published research.
collection.license: Works of the U.S. Government are in the public domain in the United States.

collection.name: Methodology and Code
collection.description: Methodology reports, statistical code, and replication materials describing how a data product was produced.
collection.intro: Documentation of process rather than of results: how the published data came to be.
collection.license: Works of the U.S. Government are in the public domain in the United States.

collection.name: Research Projects
collection.description: Research packages that tie a body of work together: publications, the data they rest on, methodology, and supporting material.
collection.intro: A project is an object in its own right, so a body of research can be cited and resolved the way its parts are.
collection.license: Works of the U.S. Government are in the public domain in the United States.
